title: Job: Where Is My Hope?

questions.question: What is broken?
questions.explanation: Job 17:1 (ESV): "My spirit is broken; my days are extinct; the graveyard is ready for me."

questions.question: Who are about me?
questions.explanation: Job 17:2 (ESV): "Surely there are mockers about me, and my eye dwells on their provocation."

questions.question: Lay down a what for me with yourself?
questions.explanation: Job 17:3 (ESV): "Lay down a pledge for me with yourself; who is there who will put up security for me?"

questions.question: He has made me a byword of the what?
questions.explanation: Job 17:6 (ESV): "He has made me a byword of the peoples, and I am one before whom men spit."

questions.question: My eye has grown dim from what?
questions.explanation: Job 17:7 (ESV): "My eye has grown dim from grief, and all my members are like a shadow."

questions.question: The upright are what at this?
questions.explanation: Job 17:8 (ESV): "The upright are appalled at this, and the innocent stirs himself up against the godless."

questions.question: Yet the righteous holds to his what?
questions.explanation: Job 17:9 (ESV): "Yet the righteous holds to his way, and he who has clean hands grows stronger and stronger."

questions.question: But you, come on again, all of you, and I shall not find a what among you?
questions.explanation: Job 17:10 (ESV): "But you, come on again, all of you, and I shall not find a wise man among you."

questions.question: My days are past; my plans are what?
questions.explanation: Job 17:11 (ESV): "My days are past; my plans are broken off, the desires of my heart."

questions.question: They make night into what?
questions.explanation: Job 17:12 (ESV): "They make night into day: 'The light,' they say, 'is near to the darkness.'"

questions.question: If I hope for Sheol as my what?
questions.explanation: Job 17:13 (ESV): "If I hope for Sheol as my house, if I make my bed in darkness,"

questions.question: If I say to the pit, You are my what?
questions.explanation: Job 17:14 (ESV): "if I say to the pit, 'You are my father,' and to the worm, 'My mother' or 'My sister,'"

questions.question: Where then is my what?
questions.explanation: Job 17:15 (ESV): "where then is my hope? Who will see my hope?"

questions.question: Will it go down to the bars of what?
questions.explanation: Job 17:16 (ESV): "Will it go down to the bars of Sheol? Shall we descend together into the dust?"

questions.question: Who closed their hearts to understanding?
questions.explanation: Job 17:4 (ESV): "Since you have closed their hearts to understanding, therefore you will not let them triumph."

key_verse_text: Yet the righteous holds to his way, and he who has clean hands grows stronger and stronger.
